crime: {WITCH_NAME} regularly laid out a girl's comb, ribbons, and wooden hair beads after the girl's evening showers and braided the girl's hair. The girl liked the braids and quiet routine, and let her choose and replace the supplies. The roommate knew the girl's plans and often walked with the girl to the shower room.

At the start of evening free time, the girl requested a braid for a casual group photo in the courtyard. While braiding, {WITCH_NAME} found one bead split along the side, removed and pocketed it for later replacement, then finished with the rest as the roommate and another participant watched. The roommate invited her into the picture, but the girl handed the phone to her instead. “You always smile after everyone else. You should take it.” {WITCH_NAME} photographed the group.

The girl, the roommate, and the other participant went straight to the shower room. Meanwhile, she headed toward the cells with the cracked bead. The girl entered the soundproof room alone, the other beads still in the braid, while both companions waited at its only entrance.

When the girl stopped answering, both companions entered together. Neither had heard the girl choke or seen anyone pass. The girl was dead, with the same split bead lodged in the airway and the other beads beside the girl's clothes.

At first, it appeared that the girl had put one of her own beads into her mouth while undoing the braid and accidentally choked. But both witnesses had watched her pocket the fatal cracked bead. They stayed together with the girl until the girl entered the shower room, then watched the entrance together; neither could have returned the bead unseen by the other. After leaving the courtyard, she held the cracked bead and used Object Transfer to send it directly into the girl's throat, blocking the airway and killing the girl.
fields.epitaph: She filled every open hand, then lay alone inside the one that never asked.
execution: An enormous iron hand opens palm-up, with her restrained on her back across its center. The fingers close in one continuous motion, pressing her legs, arms, torso, and head into the palm and crushing her skull, shoulders, ribs, chest, pelvis, and spine. The hand finishes as a fist around her crushed corpse.

magic.name: Object Transfer
magic.text: She can instantly move an object she is holding to another place she chooses.
